dimensions.assessment: Affects individuals and households residing in areas experiencing qualifying prolonged power outages affecting at least 10 percent of consumers in a political subdivision for 72 hours or more.
dimensions.evidence: affects not fewer than 10 percent of consumers in a political subdivision of a State for not fewer than 72 hours

dimensions.assessment: Provides federal assistance for serious needs, medical and dental costs, displacement, lodging, and personal property during extended outages.
dimensions.evidence: provide assistance to individuals and households in accordance with section 408 ... for serious needs, medical and dental costs, displacement costs

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes federal disaster relief expenditures for events that might not otherwise receive a major disaster declaration, though funding amounts are not specified.
dimensions.evidence: regardless of whether a major disaster is declared under section 401

dimensions.assessment: Amends Title IV of the Robert T. Stafford Disaster Relief and Emergency Assistance Act by adding a new designated assistance category.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change to federal disaster relief authorities.

importance_detail.rationale: Amends the Stafford Act to permit individual and household disaster assistance during prolonged power outages meeting specific criteria, regardless of a major disaster declaration.
